rendering: Unscaled runtime Phaser layers: body, head, pants, shirt, boots, hair. Global game textures are shared by characters.

validation.nonemptyLayers: Every 64x64 frame in all 48 unique runtime sheets has nontransparent pixels for every direction and action. Ivar and Sigrid reuse 24 existing body/head/pants/boots sheets.

feetAnchor.note: Ground reference equals the common idle sole baseline. Walk toes can extend to y=64; run raises the feet. Preserve these authored animation offsets.

animationCoverage.idle: All six layers, all four directions, three frames per direction.
animationCoverage.walk: All six layers, all four directions, eight frames per direction.
animationCoverage.run: Dedicated run sheets for all six layers, all four directions, eight frames per direction. No walk fallback.
